nodes.code:
import re
from datetime import date

result = api.connectors.invoke(server="xero-payroll-au", tool="list_pay_runs", args={"where": 'PayRunStatus=="DRAFT"', "order": "PaymentDate ASC"})
pay_runs = result.get("PayRuns", []) if isinstance(result, dict) else []

review_window_days = 3
due = False
pay_run_id = ""
payment_date_text = "N/A"

if pay_runs:
    first = pay_runs[0]
    pay_run_id = first.get("PayRunID", "")
    raw_date = first.get("PaymentDate", "") or ""
    m = re.search(r"/Date\((\d+)", raw_date)
    if m:
        epoch_ms = int(m.group(1))
        payment_date = date.fromtimestamp(epoch_ms / 1000)
        payment_date_text = payment_date.isoformat()
        due = (payment_date - date.today()).days <= review_window_days

outputs.description: Whether the earliest Draft pay run's payment date is within the review window.
outputs.name: due

outputs.description: The Draft pay run's Xero PayRunID, empty if none.
outputs.name: pay_run_id

outputs.description: The pay run's payment date as YYYY-MM-DD, or N/A.
outputs.name: payment_date_text

result = api.connectors.invoke(server="xero-payroll-au", tool="get_payroll_readiness_check", args={})
ready = bool(result.get("notReadyCount", 0) == 0 and result.get("balanceConflictCount", 0) == 0)
not_ready_count = result.get("notReadyCount", 0)
balance_conflict_count = result.get("balanceConflictCount", 0)

blocking_lines = []
for emp in result.get("employees", []):
    if not emp.get("ready", True) or emp.get("hasBalanceConflict"):
        missing = ", ".join(emp.get("missingFields", []))
        line = "- " + emp.get("name", "Unknown")
        if missing:
            line += ": missing " + missing
        if emp.get("hasBalanceConflict"):
            line += " (leave balance conflict)"
        blocking_lines.append(line)
blocking_summary = "\n".join(blocking_lines) if blocking_lines else "None"

outputs.description: True only when no employees are not-ready and none have a balance conflict.
outputs.name: ready

outputs.description: Count of employees missing required fields.
outputs.name: not_ready_count

outputs.description: Count of employees whose requested leave exceeds their balance.
outputs.name: balance_conflict_count

outputs.description: Markdown bullet list naming each blocking employee and their specific issue, or "None".
outputs.name: blocking_summary

nodes.summary: Runs the payroll readiness check -- missing employee fields or unresolved leave balance conflicts block the review.

processing = api.connectors.invoke(server="xero-payroll-au", tool="get_payroll_processing", args={})
timesheets = api.connectors.invoke(server="xero-payroll-au", tool="get_timesheet_approval_check", args={})
hours = api.connectors.invoke(server="xero-payroll-au", tool="get_hours_reconciliation", args={})

totals = processing.get("totals", {}) if isinstance(processing, dict) else {}
vs_last = processing.get("vsLastRun", {}) if isinstance(processing, dict) else {}
wages = totals.get("wages")
tax = totals.get("tax")
super_amt = totals.get("super")
net_pay = totals.get("netPay")
vs_last_label = vs_last.get("label", "N/A")
all_approved = bool(timesheets.get("allApproved")) if isinstance(timesheets, dict) else False
all_matched = bool(hours.get("allMatched")) if isinstance(hours, dict) else False

description = (
    "Pay run paid " + payment_date_text + ". Wages $" + str(wages) + ", tax $" + str(tax) + ", super $" + str(super_amt) +
    ", net pay $" + str(net_pay) + " (vs last run " + str(vs_last_label) + ").\n\n" +
    "Timesheets all approved: " + str(all_approved) + ". Hours all matched: " + str(all_matched) + ".\n\n" +
    "Open the **Payroll Summary for Client** report on the Reports tab for full live figures.\n\n" +
    "1. Reviewer: check the figures above and the report, then comment your approval or decline here.\n" +
    "2. Only after the reviewer approves: send the pack to the client and record their approval or decline as a comment here too.\n" +
    "3. Mark this item done once both approvals are recorded."
)

item = api.workq.create(
    title="Review and approve payroll summary (" + payment_date_text + ")",
    description=description,
    priority="high",
)
item_id = item["id"]
